**Offline‑download complaints are increasing**

- The “Offline Download Limits Frustration” theme (spotify‑t6) grew **62 %** in recent weeks, the highest growth among feature‑related issues【#spotify‑t6】.  
- Weekly negative counts remain steady‑to‑high: after a dip in early‑April, negatives rose again in May (12‑9‑7 per week) and stayed around 7‑13 per week through early July【#spotify‑t6】.  

**What customers are saying**

- “Frequent issues playing downloaded songs when offline” (May 29)【#rv_1168224778834896598】  
- “Offline mode does not show my downloaded songs… when I go online it says they are downloaded” (Feb 22)【#rv_8657860390041559815】  
- “Songs sometimes disappear from my downloads without warning” (May 7)【#sv_45】  
- “We can't download songs to listen when we're offline” (June 6)【#rv_7731442437018229164】  

**Conclusion**

Negative feedback about offline downloads is not only persisting but has **accelerated** in the second half of the period, indicating the issue is getting worse rather than improving.
